name: GoldenEye VR
summary: GoldenEye 007 running natively on Meta Quest: a free, from-source port of the N64 classic built on the GoldenEye decompilation. Play in true stereo VR, aiming and swinging with your real hands and checking Bond's watch on your wrist, or on a giant flat or curved virtual screen. Online deathmatch for up to 8 with bots, the campaign in co-op for up to 4, 3D sound, optional HD textures and GoldenEye X models. Bring your own GoldenEye 007 (USA) ROM; no game data included.
